title: Special Topics in Biology; Physiology of Pain and Evidence-based CAM Approaches
description:
Introduction to the physiology of pain and the philosophies, techniques, and evidence of efficacy of complementary and alternative therapies used to treat pain/chronic pain disorders, including massage therapy, dietary, mind-body practices, acupuncture, energy therapies, and Ayurvedic practices.

Credit cannot be applied to the requirements of any Biological Sciences Major.
